title: Confit eggs
creator: byrontalbott
statusNote: The full recipe is on the creator's Substack. The ≈ amounts and steps are reconstructed from the video.

items.note: absorbed; you need about 200 ml to confit the yolks (reuse it after)

steps: Warm the olive oil to a low temperature (about 60 °C).
Slip the yolks into the oil and confit them gently until thickened but still runny.
Lift out, season with flaky salt and use on toast, pasta, rice or salads.
